title: Exact-batch physical inventory correction allocation prerequisite

discoveryEvidence.movementRequirement: Every canonical physical inventory movement binds one exact production batch id/version and one exact SKU id/version.
discoveryEvidence.reconciliationBoundary: FOOD-006R produces an exact-SKU variance and explicitly introduces no batch-level identity inference.
discoveryEvidence.allocationPolicy: No canonical automatic batch-allocation or lot-selection policy was found.
discoveryEvidence.movementPersistence: An existing append-only D1 physical inventory movement writer exists, but FOOD-006S does not invoke it.
discoveryEvidence.sequenceIntegration: Migration 0005 definition would sequence later persisted physical movements into exact-SKU inventory evidence, but migration 0005 remains unexecuted.
discoveryEvidence.countReconciliationPersistence: No durable FOOD-006Q physical-count or FOOD-006R reconciliation storage was found.

decision: FOOD-006S is a pure caller-supplied exact-batch correction allocation plan. It does not automatically choose batches and does not create or persist physical inventory movements.

input.allocations: Caller-supplied array of exact production-batch id/version plus positive packageCount.

agreement: A zero reconciliation variance requires an empty allocation array and returns no-correction-required.

nonzeroVariance.positive: Positive counted-minus-recorded variance derives proposedMovementType adjustment-in.
nonzeroVariance.negative: Negative counted-minus-recorded variance derives proposedMovementType adjustment-out.
nonzeroVariance.waste: FOOD-006S never derives waste from reconciliation variance.

batchRules: Every allocation must reference an exact production batch already present in the FOOD-006P recorded composition retained by FOOD-006R.
Unknown batch ids or versions are rejected.
Duplicate exact batch allocations are rejected.
No FIFO, FEFO, oldest-batch, newest-batch or other automatic allocation policy is invented.
Allocation package counts are positive safe integers.
Allocation totals use exact BigInt arithmetic and must equal the absolute FOOD-006R variance exactly.
Output allocation order is canonical by batch id then version.
FOOD-006S does not claim that a caller-selected batch allocation is physically truthful.
FOOD-006S does not infer per-batch physical quantity from the exact-SKU count observation.
FOOD-006S does not prohibit a resulting future recorded per-batch balance from becoming negative; recorded negative balances remain discrepancy evidence rather than literal negative stock.
movementBoundary: The result is not a FoodPhysicalInventoryMovement.
A later explicit slice may transform a reviewed allocation plan into movement candidates and separately persist them.
doesNotEstablish: physical truth of the count observation
physical truth of caller batch allocation
